task: worker-3 hit repeated kernel global OOM (prometheus-0 killed 16 times in ~3h) because prometheus, tempo and loki were all scheduled on it and loki was BestEffort. Make loki Burstable and make the three prefer different workers.

events.summary: Change only loki singleBinary/sidecar resources and preferred hostname pod anti-affinity on prometheus, tempo and loki. Deliberately left alone: retention, storage sizes, scrape config, prometheus and tempo resources, the loki-canary DaemonSet (monitoring.lokiCanary.enabled false does not control it in chart 18.4.0), worker RAM, live cluster (read-only kubectl get only), Gitea, node-level scheduling policy.

2026-11-06 worker-3 (77% usage, 5.3GiB allocatable): prometheus-0 OOM-killed 16 times in ~3h by the kernel killer, not its 2Gi limit; prometheus (1.25Gi), tempo-0 (593Mi) and loki-0 (loki 127Mi + loki-sc-rules 72Mi, resources {} = BestEffort) all on worker-3 while worker-2 was at 53%. Live labels: loki-canary DaemonSet pods carry app.kubernetes.io/name=loki on every node.

D-MON-QOS-LOKI: loki singleBinary.resources (100m/256Mi, limit 768Mi) and sidecar.resources (10m/64Mi, limit 192Mi). D-MON-SPREAD: one preferred (weight 100) hostname anti-affinity term per other pod on prometheus (prometheusSpec.affinity with podAntiAffinity disabled), tempo (affinity) and loki (singleBinary.affinity); the loki term also requires component=single-binary so loki-canary does not match.

events.summary: In the repository loki and loki-sc-rules are Burstable and the three monitoring pods prefer different workers, pinned by R311. Anti-affinity only applies when a pod is rescheduled; whether they actually land on different workers is not demonstrated and needs push-to-gitea, a sync and deleting tempo-0, loki-0 and the prometheus pod one at a time.
Complete for the repository scope; not deployed, no live placement or OOM verification, worker memory overcommit unchanged.
